alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency deviation is far smaller (z=69 vs z=893) and it follows from slow inbound calls to recommendationservice (E1, E2).

It does not appear among the significant deviations in the all-services metric ranking (E1). The extra latency sits on the inbound call to recommendationservice, not in time spent downstream of it (E2).
Its own span self-time is essentially unchanged (1.0 to 1.02ms). CPU starvation would inflate processing time; only network-path latency grew (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Find and remove the network delay on recommendationservice's network path (for example a tc/netem qdisc or fault-injection rule on its pod or sidecar). Restart or reschedule the pod only if the delay cannot be cleared in place. Then confirm that frontend and recommendationservice latency p50/p90 return to baseline.
